title: Paul Gordan and Clebsch-Gordan: Source-Witnessed LaTeX and Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Paul Gordan / Clebsch-Gordan record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record contains source-witnessed German/Latin transcription and English translation working packets split out from the older mixed additional-author shelf.

Status at a glance. These are package-audited working drafts, not final critical editions. OCR is used only as a non-authoritative prose/block comparator; source renders and included scan witnesses remain the authority for formulas and mathematical readings.

Latest update. Adds Gordan_Abel21_p279_291_DE_EN_20260612.zip, covering Clebsch-Gordan Theorie der Abelschen Functionen source pp.279-291 / printed pp.257-269. It completes the continuation of §74, all of §75, and all of §76, with cumulative Abelsche German/English TeX/PDF through source p291, current and cumulative source-scan witnesses, formula crops/ledgers, render checks, and clean build logs. The audit reports no unresolved scan-quality blocker and keeps OCR scaffold excerpts non-authoritative. The next continuation point is source p292 / printed p270, Elfter Abschnitt, §77.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Adds Abel21 p279-p291, extending the cumulative Abelsche stream through source p291 / printed p269. Abel21 completes the continuation of §74, all of §75, and all of §76; next continuation is source p292 / printed p270, §77. Package-audited working drafts only; OCR scaffold remains noncanonical.
